```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# PATHWAY ENRICHMENT
# FINAL WGCNA POWER = 4
#
# GO Biological Process
# Reactome
# MSigDB Hallmark
#
# Module genes:
#   Gene_Module_Assignments.csv
#
# Selected modules:
#   Top_Positive_Module_Per_Cluster.csv
#   Top_Negative_Module_Per_Cluster.csv
# ============================================================


suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(ReactomePA)
  library(msigdbr)
  library(ggplot2)
})


# ============================================================
# 1. Paths
# ============================================================

base_dir <- paste0(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/",
  "WCNA/NMFcluster/K3/Soft_Power_4"
)

gene_assignment_file <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "Gene_Module_Assignments.csv"
)

top_pos_file <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "Top_Positive_Module_Per_Cluster.csv"
)

top_neg_file <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "Top_Negative_Module_Per_Cluster.csv"
)

output_dir <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "Pathway_Enrichment"
)

dir.create(
  output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

cat("\nOutput directory:\n")
cat(output_dir, "\n")


# ============================================================
# 2. Read files
# ============================================================

gene_assign <- read.csv(
  gene_assignment_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

top_pos <- read.csv(
  top_pos_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

top_neg <- read.csv(
  top_neg_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# 3. Basic checks
# ============================================================

stopifnot(
  all(
    c(
      "Gene",
      "MergedModule"
    ) %in% colnames(gene_assign)
  )
)

stopifnot(
  all(
    c(
      "Module",
      "Trait",
      "r",
      "p",
      "FDR",
      "direction"
    ) %in% colnames(top_pos)
  )
)

stopifnot(
  all(
    c(
      "Module",
      "Trait",
      "r",
      "p",
      "FDR",
      "direction"
    ) %in% colnames(top_neg)
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 4. Selected module associations
# ============================================================

selected_modules <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  top_pos,
  top_neg
)

cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("SELECTED MODULE ASSOCIATIONS\n")
cat("============================================\n")

print(
  selected_modules[
    ,
    c(
      "Module",
      "Trait",
      "r",
      "p",
      "FDR",
      "direction"
    )
  ]
)


# Expected power-4 modules
expected_modules <- c(
  "darkolivegreen",
  "navajowhite2",
  "black",
  "coral2",
  "darkgreen"
)

observed_modules <- unique(
  selected_modules$Module
)

if (!setequal(
  expected_modules,
  observed_modules
)) {

  stop(
    "Selected modules do not match final power-4 analysis."
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 5. Confirm module sizes
# ============================================================

module_counts <- table(
  gene_assign$MergedModule
)

cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("SELECTED MODULE SIZES\n")
cat("============================================\n")

print(
  module_counts[
    expected_modules
  ]
)


# ============================================================
# 6. Robust mapping function
# SYMBOL + Ensembl -> SYMBOL + ENTREZ
# ============================================================

map_gene_ids <- function(gene_ids) {

  gene_ids <- unique(
    trimws(
      as.character(gene_ids)
    )
  )

  gene_ids <- gene_ids[
    !is.na(gene_ids) &
      gene_ids != ""
  ]


  # Remove Ensembl version suffix
  clean_ids <- sub(
    "\\.[0-9]+$",
    "",
    gene_ids
  )


  input_df <- data.frame(
    Original_ID = gene_ids,
    Clean_ID = clean_ids,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )


  ens_ids <- unique(
    clean_ids[
      grepl(
        "^ENSG",
        clean_ids
      )
    ]
  )


  symbol_ids <- unique(
    clean_ids[
      !grepl(
        "^ENSG",
        clean_ids
      )
    ]
  )


  mapping_list <- list()


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # HGNC symbols
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (length(symbol_ids) > 0) {

    symbol_map <- AnnotationDbi::select(
      org.Hs.eg.db,
      keys = symbol_ids,
      keytype = "SYMBOL",
      columns = c(
        "SYMBOL",
        "ENTREZID"
      )
    )

    symbol_map$Clean_ID <- symbol_map$SYMBOL
    symbol_map$Input_Type <- "SYMBOL"

    symbol_map <- symbol_map[
      ,
      c(
        "Clean_ID",
        "SYMBOL",
        "ENTREZID",
        "Input_Type"
      ),
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    mapping_list[["SYMBOL"]] <- symbol_map
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Ensembl IDs
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (length(ens_ids) > 0) {

    ensembl_map <- AnnotationDbi::select(
      org.Hs.eg.db,
      keys = ens_ids,
      keytype = "ENSEMBL",
      columns = c(
        "SYMBOL",
        "ENTREZID"
      )
    )

    ensembl_map$Clean_ID <- ensembl_map$ENSEMBL
    ensembl_map$Input_Type <- "ENSEMBL"

    ensembl_map <- ensembl_map[
      ,
      c(
        "Clean_ID",
        "SYMBOL",
        "ENTREZID",
        "Input_Type"
      ),
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    mapping_list[["ENSEMBL"]] <- ensembl_map
  }


  mapping <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    mapping_list
  )


  mapping <- dplyr::left_join(
    input_df,
    mapping,
    by = "Clean_ID"
  )


  mapping <- dplyr::distinct(
    mapping
  )


  return(mapping)
}


# ============================================================
# 7. Background universe
# ============================================================

background_genes <- unique(
  gene_assign$Gene
)

cat(
  "\nTotal WGCNA genes:",
  length(background_genes),
  "\n"
)


background_map <- map_gene_ids(
  background_genes
)


background_entrez <- unique(
  background_map$ENTREZID[
    !is.na(
      background_map$ENTREZID
    )
  ]
)


background_symbols <- unique(
  background_map$SYMBOL[
    !is.na(
      background_map$SYMBOL
    )
  ]
)


cat(
  "Background mapped ENTREZ:",
  length(background_entrez),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Background mapped SYMBOL:",
  length(background_symbols),
  "\n"
)


write.csv(
  background_map,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "Background_Gene_ID_Mapping.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# 8. Hallmark gene sets
# ============================================================

hallmark_sets <- tryCatch(

  msigdbr(
    species = "Homo sapiens",
    collection = "H"
  ),

  error = function(e) {

    msigdbr(
      species = "Homo sapiens",
      category = "H"
    )
  }
)


hallmark_sets <- hallmark_sets[
  ,
  c(
    "gs_name",
    "gene_symbol"
  )
]

hallmark_sets <- unique(
  hallmark_sets
)


cat(
  "\nHallmark gene sets:",
  length(
    unique(
      hallmark_sets$gs_name
    )
  ),
  "\n"
)


# ============================================================
# 9. Modules to enrich
# ============================================================

modules_to_enrich <- unique(
  selected_modules$Module
)

cat(
  "\nUnique modules to enrich:",
  length(modules_to_enrich),
  "\n"
)

print(
  modules_to_enrich
)


# ============================================================
# 10. Storage
# ============================================================

summary_list <- list()

all_GO <- list()

all_Reactome <- list()

all_Hallmark <- list()


# ============================================================
# 11. Enrichment loop
# ============================================================

for (target_module in modules_to_enrich) {


  cat("\n")
  cat("====================================================\n")
  cat(
    "Pathway enrichment:",
    target_module,
    "\n"
  )
  cat("====================================================\n")


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Module-cluster association
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  assoc <- selected_modules[
    selected_modules$Module == target_module,
  ]


  association_label <- paste0(
    assoc$Trait,
    "_",
    assoc$direction,
    collapse = ";"
  )


  cat(
    "Cluster association(s):",
    association_label,
    "\n"
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Extract module genes
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  module_genes <- unique(
    gene_assign$Gene[
      gene_assign$MergedModule ==
        target_module
    ]
  )


  cat(
    "Genes in module:",
    length(module_genes),
    "\n"
  )


  # Save raw module genes
  write.csv(
    data.frame(
      Gene = module_genes
    ),
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(
        target_module,
        "_Module_Genes.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Gene-ID mapping
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  module_map <- map_gene_ids(
    module_genes
  )


  module_entrez <- unique(
    module_map$ENTREZID[
      !is.na(
        module_map$ENTREZID
      )
    ]
  )


  module_symbols <- unique(
    module_map$SYMBOL[
      !is.na(
        module_map$SYMBOL
      )
    ]
  )


  cat(
    "Mapped ENTREZ:",
    length(module_entrez),
    "/",
    length(module_genes),
    sprintf(
      "(%.1f%%)",
      100 *
        length(module_entrez) /
        length(module_genes)
    ),
    "\n"
  )


  cat(
    "Mapped SYMBOL:",
    length(module_symbols),
    "/",
    length(module_genes),
    sprintf(
      "(%.1f%%)",
      100 *
        length(module_symbols) /
        length(module_genes)
    ),
    "\n"
  )


  write.csv(
    module_map,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(
        target_module,
        "_Gene_ID_Mapping.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # GO BIOLOGICAL PROCESS
  # ==========================================================

  ego <- enrichGO(
    gene = module_entrez,
    universe = background_entrez,
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
    keyType = "ENTREZID",
    ont = "BP",
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    pvalueCutoff = 1,
    qvalueCutoff = 1,
    readable = TRUE
  )


  go_df <- as.data.frame(
    ego
  )


  if (nrow(go_df) > 0) {

    go_df$Module <- target_module
    go_df$Association <- association_label

    go_df <- go_df[
      order(
        go_df$p.adjust
      ),
    ]
  }


  write.csv(
    go_df,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(
        target_module,
        "_ORA_GO_BP_ALL.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  go_sig <- go_df[
    !is.na(go_df$p.adjust) &
      go_df$p.adjust < 0.05,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  write.csv(
    go_sig,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(
        target_module,
        "_ORA_GO_BP_FDRlt0.05.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # Reactome
  # ==========================================================

  reactome <- enrichPathway(
    gene = module_entrez,
    universe = background_entrez,
    organism = "human",
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    pvalueCutoff = 1,
    qvalueCutoff = 1,
    readable = TRUE
  )


  reactome_df <- as.data.frame(
    reactome
  )


  if (nrow(reactome_df) > 0) {

    reactome_df$Module <- target_module
    reactome_df$Association <-
      association_label

    reactome_df <- reactome_df[
      order(
        reactome_df$p.adjust
      ),
    ]
  }


  write.csv(
    reactome_df,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(
        target_module,
        "_ORA_Reactome_ALL.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  reactome_sig <- reactome_df[
    !is.na(reactome_df$p.adjust) &
      reactome_df$p.adjust < 0.05,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  write.csv(
    reactome_sig,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(
        target_module,
        "_ORA_Reactome_FDRlt0.05.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # Hallmark
  # ==========================================================

  hallmark <- enricher(
    gene = module_symbols,
    universe = background_symbols,
    TERM2GENE = hallmark_sets,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    pvalueCutoff = 1,
    qvalueCutoff = 1
  )


  hallmark_df <- as.data.frame(
    hallmark
  )


  if (nrow(hallmark_df) > 0) {

    hallmark_df$Module <-
      target_module

    hallmark_df$Association <-
      association_label

    hallmark_df <- hallmark_df[
      order(
        hallmark_df$p.adjust
      ),
    ]
  }


  write.csv(
    hallmark_df,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(
        target_module,
        "_ORA_Hallmark_ALL.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  hallmark_sig <- hallmark_df[
    !is.na(hallmark_df$p.adjust) &
      hallmark_df$p.adjust < 0.05,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  write.csv(
    hallmark_sig,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(
        target_module,
        "_ORA_Hallmark_FDRlt0.05.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # Summary statistics
  # ==========================================================

  min_go_raw <- if (
    nrow(go_df) > 0
  ) {
    min(
      go_df$pvalue,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }


  min_go_fdr <- if (
    nrow(go_df) > 0
  ) {
    min(
      go_df$p.adjust,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }


  min_reactome_raw <- if (
    nrow(reactome_df) > 0
  ) {
    min(
      reactome_df$pvalue,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }


  min_reactome_fdr <- if (
    nrow(reactome_df) > 0
  ) {
    min(
      reactome_df$p.adjust,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }


  min_hallmark_raw <- if (
    nrow(hallmark_df) > 0
  ) {
    min(
      hallmark_df$pvalue,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }


  min_hallmark_fdr <- if (
    nrow(hallmark_df) > 0
  ) {
    min(
      hallmark_df$p.adjust,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }


  summary_list[[target_module]] <-
    data.frame(

      Module = target_module,

      Association =
        association_label,

      N_Module_Genes =
        length(module_genes),

      N_Mapped_ENTREZ =
        length(module_entrez),

      N_Mapped_SYMBOL =
        length(module_symbols),

      GO_BP_N_Tested =
        nrow(go_df),

      GO_BP_Nominal_Plt0.05 =
        sum(
          go_df$pvalue < 0.05,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      GO_BP_FDRlt0.05 =
        nrow(go_sig),

      GO_BP_Min_P =
        min_go_raw,

      GO_BP_Min_FDR =
        min_go_fdr,

      Reactome_N_Tested =
        nrow(reactome_df),

      Reactome_Nominal_Plt0.05 =
        sum(
          reactome_df$pvalue < 0.05,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      Reactome_FDRlt0.05 =
        nrow(reactome_sig),

      Reactome_Min_P =
        min_reactome_raw,

      Reactome_Min_FDR =
        min_reactome_fdr,

      Hallmark_N_Tested =
        nrow(hallmark_df),

      Hallmark_Nominal_Plt0.05 =
        sum(
          hallmark_df$pvalue < 0.05,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      Hallmark_FDRlt0.05 =
        nrow(hallmark_sig),

      Hallmark_Min_P =
        min_hallmark_raw,

      Hallmark_Min_FDR =
        min_hallmark_fdr,

      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )


  all_GO[[target_module]] <-
    go_df

  all_Reactome[[target_module]] <-
    reactome_df

  all_Hallmark[[target_module]] <-
    hallmark_df


  cat(
    "\nGO BP:",
    nrow(go_sig),
    "FDR-significant;",
    "minimum FDR =",
    signif(
      min_go_fdr,
      4
    ),
    "\n"
  )


  cat(
    "Reactome:",
    nrow(reactome_sig),
    "FDR-significant;",
    "minimum FDR =",
    signif(
      min_reactome_fdr,
      4
    ),
    "\n"
  )


  cat(
    "Hallmark:",
    nrow(hallmark_sig),
    "FDR-significant;",
    "minimum FDR =",
    signif(
      min_hallmark_fdr,
      4
    ),
    "\n"
  )


  cat(
    "\nCompleted:",
    target_module,
    "\n"
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 12. Combined output
# ============================================================

summary_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  summary_list
)

combined_GO <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  all_GO
)

combined_Reactome <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  all_Reactome
)

combined_Hallmark <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  all_Hallmark
)


write.csv(
  summary_df,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "Pathway_Enrichment_Summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  combined_GO,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "All_Selected_Modules_ORA_GO_BP.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  combined_Reactome,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "All_Selected_Modules_ORA_Reactome.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  combined_Hallmark,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "All_Selected_Modules_ORA_Hallmark.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# 13. Final report
# ============================================================

cat("\n")
cat("====================================================\n")
cat("PATHWAY ENRICHMENT COMPLETE\n")
cat("====================================================\n")

print(
  summary_df
)

cat(
  "\nResults saved in:\n",
  output_dir,
  "\n"
)
```
